infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kwanya needs access to your microphone so you can record voice messages in Hausa. Your recordings are sent to our AI assistant to generate a spoken response. The microphone is only activated when you tap the record button.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Kwanya uses speech recognition to convert your voice recordings into text so the AI assistant can understand your message and reply in Hausa.
